en: A black‑and‑white view of a formal public garden or park with manicured hedges, rose beds, young trees on stakes, and wide gravel paths. In the background stands a large, multi‑storey brick building with a mansard‑like roof and many evenly spaced windows, typical of a late 19th–early 20th century European institutional or residential building. The composition is panoramic, as if meant to showcase both the ornamental gardens and the imposing structure behind them.
